title: Can't believe Jules is a sausage dog father
text: can’t believe Jules is a sausage dog father NO ONE SPEAK TO ME 🥹🐶 https://t.co/nuoVaAjdJP
blurb: A tiny long-haired dachshund puppy gets a 'Welcome to the family' cuddle from a beaming new dad in a backyard strung with bunting. The poster is clearly overjoyed that Jules is now a sausage dog father.
